page.notes: Marginal "Quæstorcs" is a poor scan; the note reads "Quæstores bonorum monasticorum" as split over four margin lines. Marks "cc" in the margin are section or catch marks, transcribed as printed. Small stray marks in the right margin near the bottom are show-through or dust and were left out. The bottom right corner shows a digitiser's watermark, left out. Doubtful words: "çommissæ" (the ç may be a printing flaw), "Quæstorcs" (for Quæstores).
